name: LienClock
tagline: Never lose your right to get paid because you missed a lien deadline.
description: Web app where a subcontractor enters a job's state, GC, and start/completion date and instantly gets every preliminary notice, lien filing, and enforcement deadline auto-calculated with email/SMS reminders. It never files anything on your behalf — it just makes sure you never miss the window to protect your own right to be paid.
ethics_concerns: Lien statutes are highly state-specific and unforgiving of defects; inaccurate templates could cause users to lose payment rights
Risk of being construed as unauthorized practice of law (UPL) if positioned as legal advice
